criteria.requirement: Verify bundled hashes and reproduce baseline, preserving immutable source.
criteria.evidence_required: Integrity output, host/toolchain inventory, fresh test logs.

criteria.requirement: Freeze language/IR semantics, ternary encoding, exact arithmetic, overflow, errors and effect ordering.
criteria.evidence_required: Versioned contract with independent boundary cases and negative tests.

criteria.requirement: Define ownership, numeric layout, runtime errors and native/JIT ABI.
criteria.evidence_required: ABI document and cross-boundary lifecycle/error tests.

criteria.requirement: Pin released backend and dependencies; prove object emission, runtime linking and minimal executable JIT spike.
criteria.evidence_required: Dependency lock, licenses, build commands, object and generated-code invocation evidence.

criteria.requirement: Compile scalar bodies, branches, explicit overloads, calls and bounded recursion to executed machine code.
criteria.evidence_required: Source, object/disassembly, executable outputs; mutation of body changes behavior.

criteria.requirement: Preserve unbounded int/ratio and intermediate checked t32 arithmetic under optimization.
criteria.evidence_required: Independent exact and overflow cases, including values beyond machine-word range.

criteria.requirement: Preserve source-located errors, assertion failures and ordered emits.
criteria.evidence_required: Success/failure differential records with independent expected results.

criteria.requirement: Run compiled scalar/weight programs with no Python runtime dependency.
criteria.evidence_required: Isolated execution, dependency/process inspection and runtime-input cases; PATH alone insufficient.

criteria.requirement: Exercise boundaries, generated cases, malformed IR and optimizer-hostile cases.
criteria.evidence_required: Reproducible corpus seeds, raw results, failure retention and regression tests.

criteria.requirement: Implement native immutable scoped traces and closure/fusion/coupling witnesses.
criteria.evidence_required: Canonical trace/certificate comparisons; reject wrong parent/scope, forged return and replay.

criteria.requirement: Execute all five repaired examples natively with exact reference behavior.
criteria.evidence_required: Commands, outputs, ordered effects and canonical evidence equality.

criteria.requirement: Inventory supported syntax and add required grammar features in documented increments.
criteria.evidence_required: Feature matrix and positive/negative parser/type/runtime tests; unsupported constructs rejected.

criteria.requirement: Use verified lowering and common runtime ABI for AOT and JIT.
criteria.evidence_required: Native/JIT/reference differential results and executed-code evidence.

criteria.requirement: Validate JIT caching, invalidation, code lifetime and runtime symbol resolution.
criteria.evidence_required: Source/ABI/options/target cache mutations; safe lifetime tests.

criteria.requirement: Guard specializations at entry and invoke generic native fallback on guard failure.
criteria.evidence_required: Both paths executed and compared; unsupported mid-function deoptimization excluded.

criteria.requirement: Discover actual hardware capabilities and distinguish unavailable counters.
criteria.evidence_required: Host/OS/toolchain identifiers, capability probes and permission failures.

criteria.requirement: Declare workloads, warmup, paired/randomized order, sample counts, timing and uncertainty before measurements.
criteria.evidence_required: Dated protocol, held-out split, practical improvement threshold and regression bound.

criteria.requirement: Measure compilation, profiling, loading, steady-state and total costs.
criteria.evidence_required: Raw timestamped observations and reproducible analysis with uncertainty; censored runs retained.

criteria.requirement: Allow learning to select only prevalidated semantically equivalent implementations.
criteria.evidence_required: Variant provenance, equivalence cases and guard/fallback results.

criteria.requirement: Retain observations at k and demonstrate influence on execution selection at k+1.
criteria.evidence_required: Reload/restart tests, retained-state changes and actual later dispatch evidence.

criteria.requirement: Compare generic, passive, frozen, active, stale/shuffled and state-removal controls.
criteria.evidence_required: Matched raw runs and distinct policy-influence vs performance conclusions.

criteria.requirement: Evaluate held-out results including overhead and regressions; preserve zero/negative gains.
criteria.evidence_required: Reproducible uncertainty analysis and fallback decisions; no positive speedup prerequisite.

criteria.requirement: Invalidate incompatible profiles and keep correct generic fallback for corrupt or mismatched state.
criteria.evidence_required: Version/target/workload/corruption tests and bounded profiling/selection costs.

criteria.requirement: Execute genuine Dec frontend/lowering bootstrap seed to stage1 to stage2 to stage3.
criteria.evidence_required: Build provenance, executed test corpus and stage2/stage3 comparison; external dependencies declared.

criteria.requirement: Deliver candidate and detached patch with clean replay onto bundled source.
criteria.evidence_required: Replay log, final source digest and artifact hashes.

criteria.requirement: Report every criterion with evidence and separate compilation/JIT/learning/performance/self-host statuses.
criteria.evidence_required: ACCEPTANCE_RESULTS.json, report, feature inventory and HANDOFF when incomplete.
